title: ÖRMINGE range with induction cooktop
description: ÖRMINGE range with induction cooktop, Stainless steel, 24" A smooth induction cooktop and convection oven with a powerful fan that circulates heat evenly, for even baking and browning every time. The spacious drawer below keeps cookware close at hand.
features: Induction hob requires cookware with magnetic base.
If you are uncertain about whether your cook- and fryware is safe to use on an induction cooktop, check with a magnet to see if the base is made of a magnetic material, which is a must.
Cord/cable not included. Wired-in installation. Installation must be made by a qualified electrician or specialist.
Installation should be made by professionals in accordance with valid local safety regulations.
You will find complete information about the installation and use of this product under the tab Assembly instructions & documents.
